title: 流れ学Ⅱ
subtitle: Fundamentals of Fluid Mechanics II
keywords: Fluid properties 2.Fluid basics 3.Momentum equation 4.Equation of fluid motion 5.Local collaboration
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) learn the fundamentals of fluid dynamics and aerodynamics (2) learn the fluid properties of air because aircraft fly in the air (3) learn the measurement principles of fluid devices (4) learn fundamental equations and their application (5) learn the flow around an object
advice: This is a fundamental fluid dynamics and aerodynamics course. Students will learn fluid properties, fluid statics, inviscid flow, and incompressible flow. We will cover the following materials: 1. Equation of fluid motion: fluid basics, continuity equation, Bernoulli equation, Euler equation, Navier-Stokes equation 2. Forces and moments on a body: lift and drag 3. Fluid and body dynamics: fundamentals of fluids, momentum equation, continuity equation, Euler equation, Navier-Stokes equation 4. Laws of similarity: flow similarity, dimensionless numbers (Reynolds, Mach numbers) 5. Momentum conservation: momentum equation Students should be aware of the teacher's instructions in the class, because the schedules of quizzes, tests and reports may change as the class progresses. Students are expected to solve the exercises by themselves to understand the course. Students are also expected to review their notebooks for better understanding. Students are expected to actively participate in the presentation and discussion.
requiredKnowledge: Acquisition of Fluid Mechanics I. Sufficient skill in mathematics and physics (dynamics)

activityGoals.body: Be able to calculate fundamental fluid computation using continuum and Bernoulli equations
Be able to compute forces acting on a body using momentum conservation
Be able to understand and explain the basics of equation of fluid motion and continuity
Be able to derive the fundamental fluid equations
Be able to explain the flows around a body
